page.layout: Two printed pages on one scan. Left page: one column of running text (dictionary entries of Greek and Hebrew names), with a page number and a letter head "B" at the top. Right page: a narrow column of marginal notes along the right edge, cut off at the binding; no running text. Reading order: left page main column, then right page margin notes top to bottom.

main_text.head: B
main_text.p: Βαράχ ὁ nomen herois ἀκλιτον, Hebr. fulgur.
Βαραχίας ὁ nomen viri, Hebr. benedicens DOMINO.
Βαρῤῥολομαῖος ὁ nomen apostoli, Hebr. filius haurientis aquas. Aliis q. βαρτολεμαῖος filius bellicosus.
Βαδηστὴς ὁ nomen viri, Hebr. filius Jesu.
Βαρδωνάς ὁ nomen viri, Hebr. filius Jonæ. ex בר filius & יונה Jonas Matth. 16.17.
Βαρναβᾶς ὁ nomen viri, Syr. filius consolationis.
Βαρσαββᾶς ὁ nomen viri, Syr. filius quietis.
Βαρτιμαῖος ὁ nomen viri, filii Timæi, Marc. 10.46.

Βεελζεβοὺλ ὁ (pro Βεελζεβοὺβ facta mutatione literæ de induistria ad contemptum,) Matth. 10.25. nomen idoli ἀκλιζὼν, Hebr. dominus muscarum. Sic dictus, quòd crederetur abigere muscas, unde Jupiter ab Ethnicis vocabatur, ἀπόμυιος, abactor muscarum.
Βελιαὰλ ὁ nomen origine Heb. Latinè sine jugo h.e. impatiens jugi, id est disciplinæ, quem Græci vocant ἀνυπόλυτον q. d. impunibilem, qui se pœnæ subducit.
Βενιαμὶν ὁ nomen viri Hebræum ἀκλιζὼν, filius dextræ.
Βεργίκη ῆς ἡ nomen mul. Gr. afferens victoriam.
Βέροια ας ἡ Berœa nomen urbis, Gr. pondenrosa.

page.notes: Right margin notes are cut off by the binding and largely illegible (Hebrew and Greek fragments, references such as "Johan. 1.28.", "Luc. 2.11", "2. Pet. 2.15", "Apoc. 7.8"); they are not transcribed. Many left-page Greek words are approximate; the Hebrew and Greek are uncertain throughout.
